title: Roblox Bye
blurb: Squeaky farewell, twin to the Roblox hi, and just as unbothered by circumstance. This is the sound of leaving — the server, the call, the conversation — delivered with exactly the same unearned cheerfulness regardless of how things went. Rage quit? Bye. Won everything and refused to explain? Bye. Emotional damage inflicted, then departure? Bye. All exits are equal in Roblox, which is genuinely quite a healthy attitude for a platform mostly populated by nine-year-olds. Deploy it as the last word in any argument you have decided not to continue. Byeeee.
origin: The cheerful farewell from Roblox voice/chat culture.
